notes.title: 1.1.4 - TRIGGER FIRE can be Configurable.
notes.content:
Hi guys! 

1.1.4 is an improvement to allow users to select if VR Joysticks trigger fires or not the Flare and the Machine Gun.

This is better for users with Valve Index and other VR devices that only have one button on in the reach of the palm of the hand or indicator finger.

Hope you are having fun with the Machine Gun we released last week! 

Other updates are coming!!!

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.1.3 - Machine gun and more six missions!
notes.content:
In the 1.1.3 update we are proud to say: The Machine Gun has finally arrived! 

We did our best to bring a new add-on to your helicopter along with specific missions for it!

The Machine Gun!

------
It was supposed to be a DLC but we will release it FREE for all of you.
It took several hours of development and a lot of effort! So I hope you like it!
If you want to give us developers an incentive, we've turned the old DLC into a "Buy me a Coffee"
------

Those are the missions we added:
- Machine Gun Tutorial
- Missile Launcher Truck
- Incoming Humvees
- Attack
- Beginning Of The War.
- Tank Apocalypse
- Free Flight: FREE to everyone, to explore The Desert!

Destroy Missile Launchers, Humvees, and Tanks - and the tanks attack you! It's not going to be easy to protect yourself, your military base and shoot at moving targets! Be ready for this amazing challenge in VR!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40099978/03b42a94045df9f833f883927fdc8b375d03c45a.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: 1.1.0 - New Missions and Compete for HIGHSCORE!
notes.content:
Hi pilots and friends,

in the last two weeks, we have been working on a new scenario! 100% brand new desert with military missions!!! You will be amazed! 

But we are not leaving you empty-handed this week, so we added 3 new missions in the lake already with some taste of what's coming up!

Also, the cool challenge of competing for the world's high score! 

- Shoot at Targets: 
   Target practice in the lake. Shoot drone targets in 3 minutes to test how many can you destroy!

- Train maintenance:
   A mission to fly close to the train while It is moving! Help the supervisor in this beautiful task!

- Race Waypoints
   Race against other players! The faster pilot will be number 1 in the world's highscore! 

Thank you all for playing and for your feedback!
Have a nice weekend!

- Train maintenance:
- Race Waypoints

notes.title: FULL VR COMPATIBILITY, MULTIPLAYER, LIVE SCENARIO, TRAINS, AIRPLANES AND MORE!
notes.content:
Hi guys! For those following all our updates, thank you very much for all feedbacks and improvements you are suggesting! We are working very hard to do everything in time!

We are summarizing everything we did since the launch of HELICOPTER SIMULATOR VR 2021!

NEW FEATURES
- Full VR Compatibility, use HOTAS, Gamepads, keyboard, and more than +1000 controllers! 
- Multiplayer mode, with a fly-together mode you can choose to play all missions.
- Casual and Expert controllers, making the physics work better for casual and expert players!
- Live scenario with trains, planes, and trees.
- HUGE amount of trees, not compromising simulation's performance! 
- Cessna 172 flying on the scenario and being part of a mission.
- 3 more missions since launch, with 15 now! 

Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: 1.0.9 - Cessna 172 and mission!
notes.content:
1.0.9 - Cessna 172 and mission!

In this week's update, we put one more mission and a new Cessna 172 on the sim! Cessna 172 takes off, lands, and makes some flights across the lake. Very cool to follow! And also we did a mission to help Cessna's pilot!

Your mission to help the Cessna pilot is simple: find a lost hiker in the mountains and bring it to the airport!

What we changed in this version:
- improvement in the speed of tree creation.
- trees are not created over the railway line anymore.
- one more mission.
- Cessna 172 making random flights all the time.
- HOTAS configuration screen saving whenever the screen is closed.


We hope you are enjoying it! If so, be sure to leave a "thumbs up" in the steam review! This REALLY helps Steam to recommend us!

Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: 1.0.8 - UPDATE TREES AND FORESTS
notes.content:
1.0.8 - UPDATE TREES AND FORESTS

Hi guys! Running to add more and more content for you!

in this week's update, we focus on performance to add trees to the scenery!

In the menu to select between NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and ULTRA.

In our tests, the medium configuration worked on ALL computers. 
With minimum GEFORCE GTX 970 video card. On modern computers, select ULTRA and no FPS loss!

Enjoy even more the landscape of this incredible scenery, now with more nature and life!

notes.title: 1.0.7 UPDATE: Train and Live Scenario!
notes.content:
Continuing our updates, in this week's [b]1.0.7 update[/b], we added a train! Along with a special mission to transport a person to a station!

Much is yet to come, especially in missions.

We optimized our game this week to "free up" some space and add lots of items! Like trees, birds, wild animals, and vehicles!

In the coming weeks, we can expect many more missions! But for now, have fun following the train and enjoying every moment of our [b]HELICOPTER SIMULATOR VR 2021[/b].

Summarising, that's what we did this week:

1.0.7
- Tracks and the Train
- Two train stations
- Mission to transport VIP to a train station
- Performance and minor bug fixes.

1.0.6
- cockpit reflection with a control from 0 to 100%, so you can choose the reflection that suits you.

1.0.5
- Now you can lock your hand on the joystick. So there is no need to hold a grab on the VR controller.
To do this, open the in-game menu and choose "Lock Joystick on Grab"
- Valve Index input problem solved. There is no need to use grab on Index, just trigger.
- On any device, you no longer need to grab to see the animation of the hand, just get close to the button.
I still like to grab it before use the trigger, but you can do whatever suits you more!
- Fixed glitch in Fuel and Weather wheel on Main Menu.
- Audio volume added: Master volume, to control the volume of all other volumes together.
- Better texture compression - increased performance!

- On any device, you no longer need to grab to see the animation of the hand, just get close to the button.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5! Interaction and textures!
notes.content:
After all your weekend feedbacks and some improvements in our TODO list, we are releasing an update today with:

- Now you can lock your hand on the joystick. So there is no need to hold a grab on VR controller.
To do this, open in-game menu and choose "Lock Joystick on Grab" 
- Valve Index input problem solved. There is no need to use grab on Index, just trigger.
- On any device, you no longer need to grab to see the animation of the hand, just get close to the button.
I still like to grab it before use the trigger, but you can do whatever suits you more!
- Fixed glitch in Fuel and Weather wheel on Main Menu.
- Audio volume added: Master volume, to control the volume of all other volumes together.
- Better texture compression - increased performance! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.0.3 - It is all about physics!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

those are the main changes we did in the algorithm of controller inputs and physics! I hope you like it! 

- Helicopter crashes easier in a hard landing.
- Helicopter moves faster when going forward.
- Helicopter suffers more the effect of higher altitude.
- Acceleration curve for throttle.

NEWS: we are finishing our tests on multiplayer mode! You will be able to fly around with other Steam players! We hope to publish this update this week!!!

- Helicopter moves faster when going forward.
- Helicopter suffers more the effect of higher altitude.

notes.title: Available now! Download Helicopter Simulation VR 2021 NOW!
notes.content:
We are very excited about today's launch! 

We have added the following features in the past few weeks:
- HOTAS support
- Gamepad support
- Customizable screen for configuring practically all the controls and joysticks that exist!
- Improvement of the lake graphics and reflection of helicopter's glasses.

After months of working on the graphic quality and performance of this amazing simulator, we are happy to finally announce its arrival!

NO MORE games without the proper VR experience, especially when it comes to [b]simulators[/b]!

Player immersion has always been our number one concern!

And the updates will continue! Get ready pilots! The best VR experience of your life is yet to come!
